Sales Tracking Dashboard

This is a dashboard to track sales for a company. It has various different views that can be toggled on/off as well as buttons that take you to different parts of the report. It is a step-up in interactivity found in standard Power Bi reports. If you are interested in seeking out my work, please contact me at my email: louis.porter.pbi@gmail.com
